A full, sharp, simultaneously diagonalized spectral classification for all dimensions replaces separate growing quadratic matrices with scalar one-dimensional integrals, and supplies exact worst- and best-observed harmonic subspaces. This is a natural complete family rather than an isolated numerical increment.
